data.name: Hrithik
data.long_meaning: The name Hrithik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hrithik', which means 'intelligent' and 'radiant'. This name is often given to babies born under the influence of the Sun or Lord Vishnu. It is believed that children with this name possess great wisdom, intelligence, and courage.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hrithik is a sacred name, believed to be a blessing from Lord Vishnu. It is said that this name bestows intelligence, courage, and a strong connection to the divine.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Hrithik resonates with the vibrations of the number 3. It signifies creativity, self-expression, and communication.

It is the name of several renowned personalities, including actors Hrithik Roshan and Hrithik Surendra Nath Chidambaram. The name conveys strength, intelligence, and radiance, making it a desirable one in the Indian community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Lord Vishnu is believed to be the preserver of the universe. Hrithik, which means intelligent and radiant, symbolizes the qualities of Lord Vishnu. By giving this name to a child, parents invoke the blessings of Lord Vishnu, hoping for their child to grow up to be a wise, strong, and radiant individual.

historical_references.reference: Hrithik Roshan is believed to be named after the ancient Hindu ruler Hrishikesh, who was a king of the Haihayas and is considered one of the 18 Maharajadhirajas of India. He is believed to have ruled between 1305 and 1325 AD.

Another theory suggests that Hrithik Roshan's name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hrishikesa', which means 'the lord of senses'. This name appears in Hindu scriptures and is also an epithet of the god Vishnu.
